instruction: My sister has difficulty with very small fonts on web apps. Could you set Chrome's minimum logical font size to at least 12 pixels to ensure better readability across all websites?

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting minimum logical font size to at least 12 pixels. The evaluator checks if minimum_logical_font_size >= 12. Logical font size is similar to minimum font size but applied at a different rendering stage, providing an additional safeguard against excessively small text.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts minimum_logical_font_size from Chrome Preferences file at OS-specific paths
Metric correctly validates that the font size is within the expected range (>= 12 pixels)
Expected value semantically correct: requires minimum of 12 pixels as specified in instruction
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to ensure settings are persisted and readable
Complete coverage: single requirement (set font size >= 12) is fully verified by evaluator
Default value of 6 on error is correct (Chrome's default) and will correctly fail verification if setting not changed
Data flow is semantically correct: getter extracts right state, metric compares right aspect, expected value is accurate
